question: Should OpenClaw adopt the ClawHub signed-sharded catalog protocol in core now, and if so what landing sequence is required for the DSSE, trust-profile, and producer prerequisites?
rationale: This is a new security-boundary and persisted-snapshot protocol rather than an established bug fix; the correct core ownership, activation point, and upgrade contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage the protocol behind prerequisites
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110037 first, approve the trust-profile direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101981, then rebase this PR with end-to-end signed-root proof.

options.title: Defer the core consumer
options.body: Keep the protocol work out of main until the ClawHub producer and production trust root are available for a complete reviewed integration.

recommendation.title: Stage the protocol behind prerequisites
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110037 first, approve the trust-profile direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101981, then rebase this PR with end-to-end signed-root proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete protocol-history signal available in the supplied context is this contributor's related DSSE and trust-profile work; current-main ownership still needs maintainer confirmation.
